claims: A passing local test suite is not a commercial, legal or visual certification.

gates.required: Written commercial rights for Silent Hill characters, title, environments and other protected material, reviewed by a qualified professional.
Replace prototype silhouettes with final reviewed animation and audio assets, with a provenance/license inventory.
Verify individual fighters, moves, stages and adaptations against precise sources; inherited generated labels do not qualify.
Uninterrupted end-to-end playthroughs, victory/defeat/retry/ending, without injected outcomes, followed by human acceptance.
Real HTTP UI, offline, cache upgrade and service worker regression; local navigation currently blocked by environment policy.
Physical controllers, keyboard layouts, touch devices, supported hardware frame-time budgets, long-session and memory tests.
Build and test platform packages/installers, updates, uninstall, and applicable signing; not satisfied by a static web ZIP.
Store agreement, rights validation, content disclosures/ratings, regional legal review and store/build review.
